free_tier.stated: no hosted tier: the project is self-hosted software for x86_64 Linux with KVM, so there is no capacity to buy; it ships a compatible API gateway and an egress filter

limits.value: self-hosted software: the client must supply x86_64 Linux with KVM, so there is no hosted capacity
CubeEgress filters egress by L7 domain and audits it, with kernel policies so traffic cannot skip inspection
cold start is 60 ms at single concurrency and the P99 is 137 ms under 50 concurrent creations

confidence_note: the repository was read on 2026-10-22 and states the KVM requirement, the benchmarked cold start and the egress gateway. There is no hosted product, so the verdict stays paid-only with a better reason: it is software the client runs

evidence.proved: 'Cube Sandbox requires an x86_64 Linux environment with KVM support' and 'Cold start benchmarked on bare-metal. 60ms at single concurrency; under 50 concurrent creations, avg 67ms, P95 90ms, P99 137ms' with 'CubeEgress  -  OpenResty-based egress security gateway: L7 domain filtering, credential injection, and access auditing', quoted

session_cap.note: a sandbox starts in 60 ms and pause/resume is supported across nodes; the client's own host sets the clocks

ps.price: the client's own host and S3
ps.durability: snapshots to S3, resumable across nodes
ps.max_retention: as long as the client keeps the snapshot

net.ports: egress through CubeEgress with L7 domain filtering
